consent.declaration:
Your raw signal: stays on this device. The tool declares it is not transmitted.
Derived data: the tool declares nothing derived from your signal is sent anywhere.
Declared by access-conformance on 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z. This is the tool’s statement, not this library’s — the library has no way to check it and does not vouch for it.

checks.name: An absent denominator reports null, never zero
checks.because: a rate of 0 with no exposure reads as a perfect device; null reads as unmeasured

checks.name: The ambiguous count is reported separately
checks.detail: 2 ambiguous activation(s), reported separately from 0 false (counts are meaningful whether or not a rate follows). No per-hour figure: exposure was below the floor, so the RATE is withheld — the separation still holds.
checks.because: collapsing ambiguous into false is the bug the three-outcome split prevents — and it is reachable by one line in the classifier

checks.name: Armed and active denominators are both tracked
checks.because: a single "per hour" hides a factor-of-two difference between watching with the switch armed and working at selection

checks.name: The report discloses whether any independent witness backed it
checks.detail: independent evidence (host confirmation or an undo) classified at least one activation
checks.because: presenting a parameterised guess as a measurement is the overclaim pattern this package refuses

checks.name: Classification parameters are reported alongside the rate
checks.because: a reader must be able to see how much of the number came from the signal and how much from a choice

checks.name: Every classification carries its basis
checks.because: an opaque verdict cannot be audited, and this number will be contested

checks.name: The timing layer advanced on the session clock
checks.because: a timing layer that never advanced, or advanced on its own clock, is the two-timebase defect that made a test in this project fail 4 of 12 runs under load

checks.name: Token emission is monotonic
checks.because: a non-monotonic read position means the highlight layer would visibly jump backwards

checks.name: A withdrawn purpose prevents activation
checks.because: a consent layer that records a decision but does not prevent processing is documentation, not consent

checks.name: The consent event chain verifies
checks.because: an event log that does not verify cannot support a claim about what was consented to

checks.name: Data handling is declared by the host, not asserted by a library
checks.detail: the host supplied a declaration and it is recorded
checks.because: a library stating what its host does with a signal is asserting something it cannot observe, and one added cloud path makes it false
